SELECT a.region AS region, AVG(a.current_mrr_usd) FILTER (WHERE a.is_active) AS avg_mrr, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.is_active) AS active_accounts
FROM accounts a
GROUP BY a.region
ORDER BY avg_mrr DESC NULLS LAST, region

SELECT SUM(i.amount_usd) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'refunded') AS refunds, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'refunded') AS refund_count
FROM invoices i

SELECT a.plan AS plan, AVG(CASE WHEN a.churned THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) FILTER (WHERE a.churned IS NOT NULL) AS churn_rate, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.churned) AS churned_accounts, COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM accounts a
WHERE a.plan IN ('Enterprise', 'Starter')
GROUP BY a.plan
ORDER BY churn_rate DESC NULLS LAST, plan

GROUP BY i.account_id
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC NULLS LAST, account_id

results.sql:
SELECT 
    CASE WHEN plan = 'Enterprise' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_enterprise,
    COUNT(*) AS account_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN invoices.status = 'churned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS churned_accounts,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN invoices.status = 'churned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) * 100 AS churn_rate
FROM 
    accounts
JOIN 
    invoices ON accounts.account_id = invoices.account_id
GROUP BY 
    is_enterprise
ORDER BY 
    churn_rate DESC
